content.title: The Real Brokerage, RE/MAX, European Wax Center, American Outdoor Brands, and PVH Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
content.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after a confluence of negative economic data pointed to a weak economy. The latest Survey of Consumer Expectations from the New York Fed revealed that households' short-term inflation expectations rose, while their outlook on the labor market deteriorated. Consumers expressed greater concern about potential job losses and expected lower earnings growth, factors that directly impact discretionary spending.

content.title: Is the End of Haiti’s Duty-Free Status Reshaping PVH’s (PVH) Apparel Supply Chain Strategy?
content.summary: In recent days, the expiration of U.S. legislation granting duty-free benefits to Haiti has threatened the majority of its garment sector, prompting American clothing brands to consider shifting production elsewhere. This development has significant implications for global apparel supply chains, especially for brands deeply involved in Haitian manufacturing partnerships and reliant on cost-effective sourcing.
